title: Replacing a skill at the manifest bound is checked without its old version or mark
notes: Each manifest here takes exactly 65,536 characters. Registering the server again replaces docs:guide's 1,024-character description with another: both at once would pass the bound. docs:guide is then marked unavailable with a reason that keeps the manifest at the bound; registering the server again replaces that mark with the skill: the mark and the skill at once would pass the bound. Cited in part: a replacement through a local operation (registration, in-memory addition, discovery) is not observed, the session having no local registration.
